title: Beat 310 - Afterglow
description: A woman in a silver satin gown sits on an ornate theater balcony railing, holding a vintage film reel as light streams from a large arched window behind her. The decaying rococo interior features peeling frescoes, a glowing crystal chandelier, and an empty auditorium below with a leather armchair in the foreground containing scattered film reels and photographs.
prompt: A woman in a flowing silver satin gown sits on a stone balcony railing inside a decaying rococo theater, holding a large vintage film reel. Warm sunset light pours through a tall arched window behind her, illuminating peeling frescoes on the walls. A sparkling crystal chandelier hangs above. In the foreground, a worn leather armchair holds scattered film reels and old photographs. Cinematic lighting, melancholic nostalgic atmosphere.
